name: DEXRouter
fix_description: functionCallWithValue(address,bytes,uint256) (0x2a011594) accepts arbitrary target address and calldata with only an isContract() check. No whitelist validation on the target. Attacker passes token contract address with transferFrom calldata to steal user-approved tokens. Fix: validate target against whitelist of approved protocols.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward arbitrary external call/access control issue: the attacker first sets malicious parameters via `update`, then invokes `functionCallWithValue` to make the victim send its BNB balance to the attacker contract. The PoC is short, requires minimal protocol-specific knowledge, and the exploit flow is only two simple external calls plus a callback/fallback stub.
